plainName: Edges, glide turns and striding, three zones
description: Three skating stations from Lesson 3. Groups move to the next zone on the whistle: riding one edge around a circle, glide turns around a pylon race track, and scooter pushes that turn into striding.
steps: A: ride the circle on one skate.
B: glide around the race track, turning at each pylon.
C: scoot with one foot, then stride with both.
cues: Lean on one skate, other foot up.

zones.name: Edge rides
zones.how: A few strides, then ride around the circle on your left skate, inside edge, without putting the other foot down. Come back on the outside edge, then switch skates.
zones.cue: Lean on one skate, other foot up.

zones.name: Race track
zones.how: Four pylons make a race track. A few strides, glide on two skates, and turn around each pylon without lifting a skate. Then go the other way.

zones.name: Scooters
zones.how: Push with one skate like a scooter, all the way down, then switch feet. Then stride: push, stretch the leg, bring it back under you.

source.label: Hockey Canada U7 Lesson 3 · 1.3.01, 1.4.12, 1.6.01, 1.1.05
source.note: Lesson 3 has six stations in two sets. We kept edge control, glide turns and striding; arm-pump glides, alternating C-cuts and stops come back in Lesson 4.
